verses.sloka: शरभङ्गे दिवम् प्राप्ते मुनि संघाः समागताः ।अभ्यगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थम् रामम् ज्वलित तेजसम्  ॥३-६-१॥
verses.transliteration: śarabhaṅge divam prāpte muni saṁghāḥ samāgatāḥ ।abhyagacchanta kākutstham rāmam jvalita tejasam  ॥3-6-1॥

translations.english: When Sarabhanga attained the heaven, all the sages collected together and came to Rama whose radiance was like fire.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चमः सगः ॥ पुण्यात्मा और ब्राह्णश्रेष्ठ शरभङ्ग जी ने ब्रह्मलोक में जा अनुःवरो से घिरे हुए पितामह ब्रह्म जी के दर्शन किए | ब्रह्मा जी शरभङ्ग को देख आनन्दित हुए ओर उनसे स्वागतव चन ब्रोले-४४॥ अरणयकाएड का पांचबाँ सरा पूरा हुआ | —%— पष्ठः सग; —B— शरभङ्के दिवं याते मुनिसङ्घाः समागताः । अभ्यगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थं रामं ज्वलिततेजसम्‌

verses.sloka: वैखानसा वालखिल्याः संप्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः ।अश्म कुट्टाः च बहवः पत्र आहाराः च तापसाः ॥३-६-२॥
verses.transliteration: vaikhānasā vālakhilyāḥ saṁprakṣālā marīcipāḥ ।aśma kuṭṭāḥ ca bahavaḥ patra āhārāḥ ca tāpasāḥ ॥3-6-2॥

translations.english: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--इन मुनिर्यों का विवरण श्रागे के चार श्लोकं में दिश्रा गया दे) जो मुनि उस समय श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास श्राए, वे केसे साधक थे, यदद नात इस विवरण के देखने से श्रवगत होती है । ] वेखानसा वालखिल्याः सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः । अश्मकुट्टाशच बहवः पत्राहाराश्च धार्मिक!

verses.sloka: दन्त उलूखलिनः च एव तथा एव उन्मज्जकाः परे ।गात्र शय्या अशय्याः च तथा एव अनवकाशिकाः ॥३-६-३॥
verses.transliteration: danta ulūkhalinaḥ ca eva tathā eva unmajjakāḥ pare ।gātra śayyā aśayyāḥ ca tathā eva anavakāśikāḥ ॥3-6-3॥

translations.english: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

verses.sloka: मुनयः सलिल आहारा वायु भक्षाः तथा अपरे ।आकाश निलयाः च एव तथा स्थण्डिल शायिनः  ॥३-६-४॥
verses.transliteration: munayaḥ salila āhārā vāyu bhakṣāḥ tathā apare ।ākāśa nilayāḥ ca eva tathā sthaṇḍila śāyinaḥ  ॥3-6-4॥

translations.english: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

verses.sloka: तथा ऊर्थ्व वासिनः दान्ताः तथा आर्द्र पट वाससः ।स जपाः च तपो नित्याः तथा पंच तपोऽन्विताः ॥३-६-५॥
verses.transliteration: tathā ūrthva vāsinaḥ dāntāḥ tathā ārdra paṭa vāsasaḥ ।sa japāḥ ca tapo nityāḥ tathā paṁca tapo'nvitāḥ ॥3-6-5॥

translations.english: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

verses.sloka: सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया ज्युक्ता दृढ योग समाहिताः ।शरभंग आश्रमे रामम् अभिजग्मुः च तापसाः  ॥३-६-६॥
verses.transliteration: sarve brāhmyā śriyā jyuktā dṛḍha yoga samāhitāḥ ।śarabhaṁga āśrame rāmam abhijagmuḥ ca tāpasāḥ  ॥3-6-6॥

translations.english: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.
translations.hindi: ये सब के सब ऋषि मुनि त्रझवचस से युक्त थे और योगाभ्यास सें ढ़ और सावधान रहने वाले थे। ये सब तपस्वी शरभङ्ग के आश्रम में श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास पहुँचे

verses.sloka: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामम् धर्म भृताम् वरम् ।ऊचुः परम धर्मज्ञम् ऋषि संघाः समागताः ॥३-६-७॥
verses.transliteration: abhigamya ca dharmajñā rāmam dharma bhṛtām varam ।ūcuḥ parama dharmajñam ṛṣi saṁghāḥ samāgatāḥ ॥3-6-7॥

translations.english: All groups of sages, who knew dharma, and were upholders of righteousness reached Rama, the supreme knower of dharma, and said:
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार के परस धमात्मा ऋषि सुनि सब वहाँ जा कर घार्सिकभ्रेष्ठ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से सावधानता पूवेक बोले

verses.sloka: त्वम् इक्ष्वाकु कुलस्य अस्य पृथिव्याः च महारथः ।प्रधानः च अपि नाथः च देवानाम् मघवान् इव ॥३-६-८॥
verses.transliteration: tvam ikṣvāku kulasya asya pṛthivyāḥ ca mahārathaḥ ।pradhānaḥ ca api nāthaḥ ca devānām maghavān iva ॥3-6-8॥

translations.english: O great charioteer you are the lord of the Ikshvaku race and of the world just like Indra, chief among the gods.
translations.hindi: ब्राह्मयाशभ्रिया--अ्म विद्यनुष्ठा न जनित ब्रह्मतर्चसेन | (गो०) षष्ठः सग ४१ हे राम ! आप इद्धवाकु वंश में प्रधान, प्रथिवीनाथ अलर हारथी हें इतना नहीं प्रत्युत जिस प्रकार देवताओं के राजा इन्द्र हैं, उसी प्रकार आप भी मुख्य लोगों के नाथ हैं । अर्थात्‌ आप राजाओं के राजा अर्थात्‌ स्वामी होने के कारण महाराज हैं

verses.sloka: विश्रुतः त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च ।पितृ व्रतत्वम् सत्यम् च त्वयि धर्मः च पुष्कलः ॥३-६-९॥
verses.transliteration: viśrutaḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaśasā vikrameṇa ca ।pitṛ vratatvam satyam ca tvayi dharmaḥ ca puṣkalaḥ ॥3-6-9॥

translations.english: You are renowned in the three worlds for your valour, for your devotion to father, and in you lies enough evidence of your adherence to truth and righteousness.

verses.sloka: त्वाम् आसाद्य महात्मानम् धर्मज्ञम् धर्म वत्सलम् ।अर्थित्वात् नाथ वक्ष्यामः तत् च नः क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tvām āsādya mahātmānam dharmajñam dharma vatsalam ।arthitvāt nātha vakṣyāmaḥ tat ca naḥ kṣantum arhasi ॥3-6-10॥

translations.english: O lord, do excuse us. We sought your help to fulfil our needs since you are at hand. You are a great soul, knower and lover of dharma.
translations.hindi: विश्रुतस्रिपु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च । ० र पितृभक्तिशच सत्यं च त्वयि धमश्च पुष्कलः !!8॥ आपका यश आर पराक्रम तीनों लोकों में ( भूमुवःस्वः लोकों में ) ) प्रसिद्ध है। आप पूर्ण पितृभक्त, सत्यवादी और साङ्गोपाङ्ग धमं का पालन करने वाले हें !६॥ त्वामासाद्य महात्मानं धमज्ञं घमवत्सलम्‌ । अर्थित्वान्नाथ वक्ष्यामस्तच नः क्षन्तुमहसि

verses.sloka: अधार्मः सुमहान् नाथ भवेत् तस्य तु भूपतेः ।यो हरेत् बलि षड् भागम् न च रक्षति पुत्रवत् ॥३-६-११॥
verses.transliteration: adhārmaḥ sumahān nātha bhavet tasya tu bhūpateḥ ।yo haret bali ṣaḍ bhāgam na ca rakṣati putravat ॥3-6-11॥

translations.english: O Lord, a king who collect one sixth of the produce as tax and yet does not protect his subjects like his children commits an act of grave injustice.
translations.hindi: ते तात ! वह राजा बड़ा अधर्मी है, जो प्रजा से पैदावारी का छुठवाँ हिस्सा राजकर में उगाह कर भी, प्रजा का पुत्रवत्‌ पालन | करता

verses.sloka: युंजानः स्वान् इव प्राणान् प्राणैः इष्टान् सुतान् इव ।नित्य युक्तः सदा रक्षन् सर्वान् विषय वासिनः ॥३-६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: yuṁjānaḥ svān iva prāṇān prāṇaiḥ iṣṭān sutān iva ।nitya yuktaḥ sadā rakṣan sarvān viṣaya vāsinaḥ ॥3-6-12॥

translations.english: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.
translations.hindi: नित्ययुक्तः-सदासावघानः । (रा०) अरण्यकाण्ड ९) ओर जो राजा सदा यत्नवान और सावधान रह कर, अपने राज्य की प्रजा की अपने प्राणों के समान रक्षा करता है

verses.sloka: प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् राम कीर्तिम् स बहु वार्षिकीम् ।ब्रह्मणः स्थानम् आसाद्य तत्र च अपि महीयते ॥३-६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti śāśvatīm rāma kīrtim sa bahu vārṣikīm ।brahmaṇaḥ sthānam āsādya tatra ca api mahīyate ॥3-6-13॥

translations.english: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.
translations.hindi: वह राजा, इस लोक में बहुबएब्यापिनी स्थायी कीर्ति प्राप्त फर, अन्त में ब्रह्मलोक में जा, विशेष सम्मान का पात्र बनता है

verses.sloka: यत् करोति परम् धर्मम् मुनिः मूल फल अशनः ।तत्र राज्ञः चतुर् भागः प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ॥३-६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: yat karoti param dharmam muniḥ mūla phala aśanaḥ ।tatra rājñaḥ catur bhāgaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ ॥3-6-14॥

translations.english: One fourth of the supreme merit a sage earns by living on fruits and roots, accrues to the king through which the people are protected righteously.
translations.hindi: घर्मेपूदेक प्रजा की रक्षा करने वाले राजा को, कन्दमूल फल खा कर, तप द्वारा ऋषि जो पुण्यफल सञ्चय करते हें, उसका चोथा भाग मिलता है

verses.sloka: सो अयम् ब्राह्मण भूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थ गणो महान् ।त्वम् नाथो अनाथवत् राम राक्षसैः हन्यते भृशम् ॥३-६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: so ayam brāhmaṇa bhūyiṣṭho vānaprastha gaṇo mahān ।tvam nātho anāthavat rāma rākṣasaiḥ hanyate bhṛśam ॥3-6-15॥

translations.english: O Rama we are a group of great sages, mostly brahmins, leading a vanaprastha life. Yet with a protector like you, we are slaughtered in large numbers like orphans.
translations.hindi: हे रामचन्द्र ! यद्द वानप्रस्थ लोग, जिनमें ब्राह्मण अधिक हैं, तुम जैसे रक्षक के रहते भी अनाथ की तरह राक्षसों द्वारा मारे जाते हैं

verses.sloka: एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनाम् भावित आत्मनाम् ।हतानाम् राक्षसैः घोरैः बहूनाम् बहुधा वने ॥३-६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: ehi paśya śarīrāṇi munīnām bhāvita ātmanām ।hatānām rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ bahūnām bahudhā vane ॥3-6-16॥

translations.english: Come and see the bodies of ascetics, who had perceived the Supreme Spirit, killed in large numbers in the forest by the fierce demons.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! आप इधर आइये और उन बहुत से आत्मदर्शी ७ हे सुनियो के मृत शरीरों को देखिये जिनको घोर राक्षसों ने भालों की चोओों से छेदकर, तलवारों से काट कर मार डाला है

verses.sloka: पंपा नदी निवासानाम् अनुमन्दाकिनीम् अपि ।चित्रकूट आलयानाम् च क्रियते कदनम् महत् ॥३-६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: paṁpā nadī nivāsānām anumandākinīm api ।citrakūṭa ālayānām ca kriyate kadanam mahat ॥3-6-17॥

translations.english: A great slaughter is taking place amongst those residing on the bank of the Pampa lake, near the river Mandakini, and on mount Chitrakuta.
translations.hindi: पस्पानदो के तटवर्ती तथा मन्दाकिनी के तट पर रहने वाले ओर चित्रकटवासी ऋषि ही बहुत मारे जाते हैं

verses.sloka: एवम् वयम् न मृष्यामो विप्रकारम् तपस्विनाम् ।क्रियमाणम् वने घोरम् रक्षोभिः भीम कर्मभिः ॥३-६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: evam vayam na mṛṣyāmo viprakāram tapasvinām ।kriyamāṇam vane ghoram rakṣobhiḥ bhīma karmabhiḥ ॥3-6-18॥

translations.english: We ascetics are not able to tolerate the fearful deeds perpetrated by the dreadful demons in the forest.
translations.hindi: हमसे, इन तपस्वियां के ये कष्ट, जो उन्हें इस वन में भयङ्कर राक्षसों द्वारा मिला करते हें, सहन नहीं होते। अथवा इस वन में भयङ्कर राक्षस तपरिवयों को जो दुःख दिअ! करते हैं, वे हमसे सहे नहीं जाते

verses.sloka: ततः त्वाम् शरणार्थम् च शरण्यम् समुपस्थिताः ।परिपालय नः राम वध्यमानान् निशाचरैः ॥३-६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tvām śaraṇārtham ca śaraṇyam samupasthitāḥ ।paripālaya naḥ rāma vadhyamānān niśācaraiḥ ॥3-6-19॥

translations.english: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.

verses.sloka: परा त्वत्तः गतिः वीर पृधिव्यम् न उपपद्यते ।परिपालय नः सर्वान् राक्षसेभ्यो नृपात्मजः ॥३-६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: parā tvattaḥ gatiḥ vīra pṛdhivyam na upapadyate ।paripālaya naḥ sarvān rākṣasebhyo nṛpātmajaḥ ॥3-6-20॥

translations.english: O great warrior here on this earth there is no protector as mighty as you. So, O prince save us all from these demons.
translations.hindi: हे वीर ! इस प्रथिवी पर तुम छोड़, दूसरा कोई हमारी रक्षा करने वाला, हमें नहीं देख पड़ता | अतः हे राजकुमार ! तुम हमारी इन राक्षसां से रक्षा करो

verses.sloka: एतत् श्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थः तापसानाम् तपस्विनाम् ।इदम् प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वान् एव तपस्विनः ॥३-६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: etat śrutvā tu kākutsthaḥ tāpasānām tapasvinām ।idam provāca dharmātmā sarvān eva tapasvinaḥ ॥3-6-21॥

translations.english: Having heard this, righteous Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty said to all the ascetics engaged in penance:
translations.hindi: , इस प्रकार उन महातपा तपस्वियों के वचन सुन, धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने उन सब तपश्वियों से उत्तर में यह कहा

verses.sloka: न एवम् अर्हथ माम् वक्तुम् आज्ञाप्यः अहम् तपस्विनाम् ।केवलेन स्व कार्येण प्रवेष्टव्यम् वनम् मया  ॥३-६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: na evam arhatha mām vaktum ājñāpyaḥ aham tapasvinām ।kevalena sva kāryeṇa praveṣṭavyam vanam mayā  ॥3-6-22॥

translations.english: You should not speak to me this way. I deserve to be commanded by the ascetics. I have not entered this forest only on a personal mission.
translations.hindi: आप लोगों का मुझसे प्रार्थना करना उचित नहीं । क्योंकि में तो तपस्बियाँ का आज्ञाकारी हूँ । सुझको केवल अपने कार्य के लिए इस वन में आया हुआ जानिए, .अथवा आप मुझे अपना काये कराने को, जिस वन में चाहिए भेज दीजिए

verses.sloka: विप्रकारम् अपाक्रष्टुम् राक्षसैः भवताम् इमम् ।पितुः तु निर्देशकरः  प्रविष्टो अहम् इदम् वनम् ॥३-६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: viprakāram apākraṣṭum rākṣasaiḥ bhavatām imam ।pituḥ tu nirdeśakaraḥ  praviṣṭo aham idam vanam ॥3-6-23॥

translations.english: I came into this forest in obedience to my father's orders to repel the aggression of demons against you.
translations.hindi: में तो आप लोगों के कष्ट को, जो आप लोगों को राक्षसा से मिलता है, दूर करने तथा पिता की आज्ञा का पालन करने ही को इस बन में आया हूँ

verses.sloka: भवताम् अर्थ सिद्ध्यर्थम् आगतोऽहम् यदृच्छया ।तस्य मे अयम् वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः  ॥३-६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: bhavatām artha siddhyartham āgato'ham yadṛcchayā ।tasya me ayam vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalaḥ  ॥3-6-24॥

translations.english: I came here to acomplish your task incidentally, Therefore, my stay in the forest will yield great results.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-प्रविष्टोऽइमिदंबनम्‌ का तात्पर्य यही है कि, यदि 'मुझे केवल पिता के आज्ञानुठार वनवास ही करना होता तो मैं यहाँ न आ कर दूसरे किप्तो बन में जा सकता था; किन्तु मुझे तो पिता की श्राज्ञा का पालन और आपके कष्टो को दूर करना था । इसी लिए मैं इस बन में आया हूँ। ] भवतामथसिद्धयथमागतो हं यहच्छया । तस्या मेऽयं बने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः

verses.sloka: तपस्विनाम् रणे शत्रून् हन्तुम् इच्छामि राक्षसान् ।पश्यन्तु वीर्यम् ऋषयः सः ब्रातुर् मे तपोधनाः ॥३-६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tapasvinām raṇe śatrūn hantum icchāmi rākṣasān ।paśyantu vīryam ṛṣayaḥ saḥ brātur me tapodhanāḥ ॥3-6-25॥

translations.english: I wish to kill in the fight the demons who are your enemies. O great ascetics, you may witness my prowess supported by my brother.
translations.hindi: तपस्विनां रणे शत्रून्‌ हन्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसान्‌ । पश्यन्तु वीर्यमृषयः सभ्रातुर्मे तपोधनाः ॥२४ में तपस्वियों के शत्रु राक्षसा का युद्धक्षेत्र में वध करना चाहता हूँ । तपोधन ऋषिगण मेरे और मेरे भाई के पराक्रम को देखें

verses.sloka: दत्त्वा अभयम् च अपि तपो धनानाम्धर्मे धृइत आत्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन ।तपो धनैः च अपि सह आर्य दत्तःसुतीक्ष्णम् एव अभिजगाम वीरः ॥३-६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: dattvā abhayam ca api tapo dhanānāmdharme dhṛita ātmā saha lakṣmaṇena ।tapo dhanaiḥ ca api saha ārya dattaḥsutīkṣṇam eva abhijagāma vīraḥ ॥3-6-26॥

translations.english: Brave Rama, steadfast in righteousness, worthy of honour, gave assurance to protect the ascetics endowed with the wealth of penance, and proceeded towards sage Sutikshna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
